# `shell/gpu-ui/GPUTextRenderer.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/shell/gpu-ui/GPUTextRenderer.js`

GPUTextRenderer.js — Level-4 GPU-native text. The browser gives us no GPU text primitive, so we rasterize each glyph ONCE with Canvas2D (white on transparent) and pack it into the engine's VGPUTextureAtlas. Drawing a string then becomes a run of tinted textured quads sampled from that atlas — fully GPU-composited, no DOM. Glyphs are cached per (sizePx, weight, char). Whitespace stores advance-only (no atlas region). Coordinates are CSS pixels, top-left origin, matching the compositor's quad space.

The browser gives us no GPU text primitive, so we rasterize each glyph ONCE with Canvas2D (white on transparent) and pack it into the engine's VGPUTextureAtlas. Drawing a string then becomes a run of tinted textured quads sampled from that atlas — fully GPU-composited, no DOM. Glyphs are cached per (sizePx, weight, char). Whitespace stores advance-only (no atlas region). Coordinates are CSS pixels, top-left origin, matching the compositor's quad space.

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
